subject: Recovering False USB Moisture Latches after Cold Weather Role Swaps
title_ko: 한랭 환경 USB Role Swap 후 Moisture 오탐 복구
summary_ko: 가상의 Android 현장 품질 회의에서 추운 날씨에 차량 USB 연결이 끊긴 직후 단말의 power role이 전환되면 실제 수분이 없는데도 USB moisture latch가 유지되어 유선 충전이 차단되는 문제를 분석한다. 팀들은 실제 오염과 ADC baseline 복원 실패를 구분하고, 안전 우회 없는 제한 복구·controller 수정·모델별 현장 gate를 결정한다. 모든 인물·조직·단말·차량·port·controller·firmware·빌드·로그·결함·수치·일정은 Business English 교육을 위한 가상 설정이며 실제 기업이나 제품의 실제 결함을 주장하지 않는다.

turns.speaker: Sora Kim
turns.en: Thanks for joining the field escalation. Field Quality, USB and BSP, Power and Charging, and Release Operations are represented. Since Monday, we have received forty-three reports that wired charging remained blocked by a moisture warning after users left a cold vehicle. Thirty-six reports involve model Kestrel Mini on build F92.3, and most users say the port was visibly dry. The common sequence is vehicle data mode, ignition off, cable removal, and wall-charger insertion within two minutes. Today we need to separate genuine contamination from a false safety latch, decide whether the rollout should pause, define a containment that never energizes a wet port, assign permanent fixes, and agree on measurable field gates and a follow-up meeting.
turns.ko: 현장 긴급 회의에 참석해 주셔서 감사합니다. 현장 품질, USB·BSP, 전원·충전, 릴리스 운영 팀이 참석했습니다. 월요일 이후 사용자가 추운 차량에서 내린 뒤 moisture 경고 때문에 유선 충전이 계속 차단됐다는 신고 43건을 받았습니다. 그중 36건은 F92.3 빌드의 Kestrel Mini이며 대부분 port가 눈에 띄게 말라 있었다고 합니다. 공통 순서는 차량 data mode, 시동 끄기, cable 제거, 2분 안에 wall charger 연결입니다. 오늘은 실제 오염과 잘못된 safety latch를 구분하고, rollout 중단 여부와 젖은 port에 절대 전원을 공급하지 않는 억제책을 정하며, 영구 수정 담당자·정량 현장 gate·후속 회의를 합의해야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Aisha Rahman
turns.en: I reviewed support calls and service inspections. Seventeen affected devices reached a service center. Swab tests found no conductive residue on fourteen, light road-salt residue on two, and visible moisture on one. The one wet device cleared normally after drying, so it does not match the persistent pattern. On the fourteen clean devices, the warning survived three cable changes and a normal reboot but cleared after the battery fell below twenty percent or after a full power-off lasting more than five minutes. That behavior points to retained controller state rather than continuing leakage. However, customer statements alone cannot establish dryness. Any remote recovery must still require electrical evidence from both configuration-channel pins and the sideband pair.
turns.ko: 지원 통화와 서비스 점검을 검토했습니다. 영향을 받은 단말 17대가 서비스 센터에 도착했습니다. swab test 결과 14대에서는 전도성 잔류물이 없었고 2대에는 가벼운 도로 염분, 1대에는 눈에 보이는 수분이 있었습니다. 젖은 1대는 건조 후 정상적으로 해제돼 지속 pattern과 일치하지 않습니다. 깨끗한 14대에서는 cable을 세 번 바꾸고 일반 reboot를 해도 경고가 유지됐지만 battery가 20% 아래로 떨어지거나 5분 이상 완전히 power-off한 뒤 해제됐습니다. 이는 지속 leakage보다 유지된 controller state를 가리킵니다. 하지만 고객 진술만으로 건조 상태를 확정할 수 없습니다. 어떤 원격 복구도 두 configuration-channel pin과 sideband pair 모두의 전기적 증거를 요구해야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Daniel Ortiz
turns.en: USB and BSP is present. The host trace shows a role swap from source to sink while the port controller is leaving vehicle accessory mode. F92.3 added a faster detach path to reduce reconnect time. On the failing model, that path requests moisture sampling before the analog block has restored its temperature-compensated baseline. The first sample is roughly eighteen percent below the warm baseline and crosses the wet threshold. The controller then sets a hardware latch, while Android records only the final wet state. A normal reboot does not reset the always-on controller, which explains persistence. I cannot yet say the latch is false in every report because salt contamination can create the same first sample. We need the complete sample sequence, not a single threshold bit.
turns.ko: USB·BSP 팀이 참석했습니다. host trace는 port controller가 vehicle accessory mode를 벗어나는 동안 source에서 sink로 role swap한 것을 보여줍니다. F92.3은 reconnect 시간을 줄이기 위해 더 빠른 detach path를 추가했습니다. 실패 모델에서 그 path는 analog block이 temperature-compensated baseline을 복원하기 전에 moisture sampling을 요청합니다. 첫 sample은 warm baseline보다 약 18% 낮고 wet threshold를 넘습니다. 이후 controller가 hardware latch를 설정하고 Android는 최종 wet state만 기록합니다. 일반 reboot는 always-on controller를 reset하지 않으므로 지속 현상이 설명됩니다. 염분 오염도 같은 첫 sample을 만들 수 있어 모든 신고가 오탐이라고는 아직 말할 수 없습니다. 단일 threshold bit가 아니라 전체 sample sequence가 필요합니다.

turns.speaker: Mei Tan
turns.en: Power and Charging is represented. Safety policy intentionally favors false positives because energizing a contaminated connector can cause corrosion or heating. I will oppose any proposal that clears the latch merely because a timer expires or a charger is reinserted. The electrical distinction is recovery shape. A dry port sampled before baseline restoration begins low, then converges toward the calibrated reference as the analog block stabilizes. Real conductive contamination remains low or becomes less stable when a small diagnostic bias is alternated. We can use that distinction only within the controller’s certified diagnostic current. The host must not apply VBUS during the test. We also need ambient and connector temperature, because a cold but dry port can converge more slowly than our laboratory profile.
turns.ko: 전원·충전 팀이 참석했습니다. 오염된 connector에 전원을 공급하면 부식이나 발열이 생길 수 있어 safety policy는 의도적으로 false positive를 선호합니다. timer가 만료됐거나 charger를 다시 꽂았다는 이유만으로 latch를 해제하는 제안에는 반대합니다. 전기적 차이는 recovery shape입니다. baseline 복원 전에 측정한 dry port는 낮게 시작한 뒤 analog block이 안정되면서 calibrated reference로 수렴합니다. 실제 전도성 오염은 낮게 유지되거나 작은 diagnostic bias를 번갈아 적용할 때 더 불안정해집니다. controller가 인증한 diagnostic current 안에서만 이 차이를 사용할 수 있습니다. test 중 host는 VBUS를 적용하면 안 됩니다. 또한 차갑지만 마른 port는 실험실 profile보다 느리게 수렴할 수 있으므로 ambient와 connector temperature도 필요합니다.

turns.speaker: Jonas Weber
turns.en: Release Operations is here. F92.3 reached thirty percent of Kestrel Mini devices in three northern markets and ten percent elsewhere. The full-size Kestrel uses a different port-controller revision and has no matching reports. Warning incidence on Mini rose from 0.7 to 8.9 per ten thousand active devices after F92.3. Ninety-two percent of events occur below five degrees Celsius, and seventy-eight percent follow a vehicle accessory session. That concentration justifies pausing expansion, but it does not justify a global rollback yet. F92.3 also fixes an unrelated charging negotiation reset. We need a model- and condition-specific decision with evidence that the old build does not expose the same latch under a different trigger.
turns.ko: 릴리스 운영 팀이 참석했습니다. F92.3은 북부 시장 3곳의 Kestrel Mini 30%와 다른 지역 10%에 도달했습니다. full-size Kestrel은 다른 port-controller revision을 사용하며 일치하는 신고가 없습니다. Mini의 경고 발생률은 F92.3 이후 active device 1만 대당 0.7건에서 8.9건으로 늘었습니다. event의 92%가 섭씨 5도 미만에서 발생하고 78%가 vehicle accessory session 뒤에 발생합니다. 이 집중도는 확대 중단을 정당화하지만 아직 global rollback을 정당화하지는 않습니다. F92.3은 별도의 charging negotiation reset도 수정합니다. 이전 build가 다른 trigger에서 같은 latch를 노출하지 않는다는 증거를 포함한 model·condition별 결정이 필요합니다.

turns.speaker: Daniel Ortiz
turns.en: I aligned controller ticks with the kernel trace using the cable-detach interrupt, which is visible on both sides. In six reproduced failures, moisture sampling starts between 2.1 and 3.4 milliseconds after analog power returns. The controller specification requires at least twelve milliseconds below zero degrees and eight milliseconds above zero. The accelerated detach change removed a fixed ten-millisecond wait because the earlier controller revision reported ready immediately. On Mini, the ready bit means digital logic is awake, not that the analog baseline is valid. That semantic mismatch is the software defect. Still, Mei is right that waiting twelve milliseconds alone cannot prove dryness. A contaminated port will also be sampled later. The permanent fix must correct sequencing and preserve independent wet detection.
turns.ko: 양쪽에서 보이는 cable-detach interrupt를 사용해 controller tick과 kernel trace를 정렬했습니다. 재현 실패 6건에서 moisture sampling은 analog power가 돌아온 뒤 2.1~3.4밀리초 사이에 시작됩니다. controller 규격은 0도 아래에서 최소 12밀리초, 0도 위에서 8밀리초를 요구합니다. 이전 controller revision이 ready를 즉시 보고했기 때문에 accelerated detach 변경이 고정 10밀리초 wait를 제거했습니다. Mini에서 ready bit는 digital logic가 깨어났다는 뜻이지 analog baseline이 유효하다는 뜻이 아닙니다. 이 의미 불일치가 software defect입니다. 그래도 12밀리초 대기만으로 건조를 증명할 수 없다는 Mei의 말이 맞습니다. 오염된 port도 나중에 sampling됩니다. 영구 수정은 순서를 바로잡으면서 독립적인 wet detection을 보존해야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Mei Tan
turns.en: Our bench matrix supports that boundary. We tested clean, distilled-water, saline-mist, and road-salt ports at minus ten, zero, and twenty degrees. Clean ports converge within twenty-eight milliseconds at minus ten. Distilled water remains below threshold for at least four hundred milliseconds. Salt can briefly approach the dry range on one pin, but the paired sideband measurement stays abnormal and the alternating-bias variance exceeds the clean limit. I disagree with using convergence on the configuration pins alone. The controller exposes four channels for a reason. The containment should require two consecutive complete four-channel scans, separated by fifty milliseconds, with temperature-adjusted margins. Any missing channel, rising variance, or contradictory pin result must keep the latch set and instruct the user to disconnect the cable.
turns.ko: bench matrix가 그 경계를 뒷받침합니다. clean, distilled-water, saline-mist, road-salt port를 영하 10도, 0도, 20도에서 시험했습니다. clean port는 영하 10도에서도 28밀리초 안에 수렴합니다. 증류수는 최소 400밀리초 동안 threshold 아래에 남습니다. 염분은 한 pin에서 잠시 dry range에 접근할 수 있지만 paired sideband measurement는 비정상으로 남고 alternating-bias variance가 clean limit를 넘습니다. configuration pin 수렴만 사용하는 데 동의하지 않습니다. controller가 네 channel을 노출하는 이유가 있습니다. 억제책은 temperature-adjusted margin을 적용한 완전한 4-channel scan 2회가 50밀리초 간격으로 연속 통과해야 합니다. channel 누락, variance 증가, pin 결과 모순이 있으면 latch를 유지하고 사용자에게 cable을 분리하라고 안내해야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Aisha Rahman
turns.en: We also reproduced a misleading recovery. If a wall charger remains attached while the latch is cleared, its pull-up changes the configuration-channel voltage and makes a contaminated fixture look closer to dry. Therefore the diagnostic must run with every external cable detached. Support cannot reliably ask users to measure that condition while the phone is unattended, so the flow needs explicit cable-state confirmation from hardware and a clear screen instruction. I propose that the device collect the two scans only after it observes detach continuously for three seconds. If the scan passes, it may clear the software copy and request the controller’s certified re-evaluation command. It must not directly clear the hardware latch. That preserves controller ownership of the final safety decision.
turns.ko: 오해를 부르는 recovery도 재현했습니다. latch를 해제할 때 wall charger가 연결돼 있으면 pull-up이 configuration-channel voltage를 바꿔 오염된 fixture가 dry에 더 가까워 보이게 합니다. 따라서 diagnostic은 모든 외부 cable이 분리된 상태에서 실행해야 합니다. 지원팀이 사용자가 자리를 비운 동안 그 조건을 측정하도록 신뢰성 있게 안내하기 어려우므로 flow에는 hardware의 명시적 cable-state 확인과 명확한 화면 안내가 필요합니다. 단말이 3초 동안 연속 detach를 관찰한 뒤에만 두 scan을 수집하도록 제안합니다. scan이 통과하면 software copy를 지우고 controller의 certified re-evaluation command를 요청할 수 있습니다. hardware latch를 직접 지우면 안 됩니다. 이렇게 해야 최종 safety 결정의 controller 소유권이 유지됩니다.

turns.speaker: Sora Kim
turns.en: We need a field containment before a firmware image is ready. Option one is to roll Kestrel Mini back to F92.2. Option two is to keep F92.3 and add the guarded re-evaluation flow through a small system component update. Option three is to tell users to power off for five minutes. The third option is operational guidance, not an engineering containment. A rollback may reintroduce the negotiation reset, which caused charging interruptions for fleet users. I prefer pausing F92.3 at its current cohorts and delivering the guarded flow only to devices with the exact Mini controller identity. However, we must prove the existing controller command performs a fresh four-channel measurement and does not simply clear the prior status.
turns.ko: firmware image가 준비되기 전에 현장 억제책이 필요합니다. 첫 선택은 Kestrel Mini를 F92.2로 rollback하는 것입니다. 둘째는 F92.3을 유지하고 작은 system component update로 guarded re-evaluation flow를 추가하는 것입니다. 셋째는 사용자에게 5분간 power off하라고 안내하는 것입니다. 세 번째는 운영 지침이지 engineering containment가 아닙니다. rollback은 fleet 사용자에게 charging interruption을 일으킨 negotiation reset을 다시 넣을 수 있습니다. F92.3을 현재 cohort에서 멈추고 정확한 Mini controller identity를 가진 단말에만 guarded flow를 제공하는 방안을 선호합니다. 다만 기존 controller command가 이전 status만 지우지 않고 새로운 4-channel measurement를 수행한다는 것을 입증해야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Daniel Ortiz
turns.en: The command named RECHECK does perform a new measurement, but firmware P17 reuses the previous baseline estimate if analog power was never cycled. That is exactly the state we distrust. We can safely request an analog-block reset without resetting the entire controller, provided no cable is attached and VBUS is absent. The reset takes thirty-five milliseconds and preserves USB policy state. I propose this sequence: verify three seconds of detach, reset only the analog block, wait the temperature-specific settle time, collect two scans, then ask RECHECK to make the final decision. If RECHECK remains wet, the host does nothing further for thirty minutes. Repeated reset loops could heat the block and distort the measurement, so the attempt must be rate-limited and recorded.
turns.ko: RECHECK라는 command는 새 measurement를 수행하지만 firmware P17은 analog power가 cycle되지 않았다면 이전 baseline estimate를 재사용합니다. 바로 그 상태를 신뢰할 수 없습니다. cable이 연결되지 않고 VBUS가 없다면 전체 controller를 reset하지 않고 analog block reset을 안전하게 요청할 수 있습니다. reset은 35밀리초 걸리고 USB policy state를 보존합니다. 3초 detach 확인, analog block만 reset, temperature별 settle time 대기, scan 2회 수집, 마지막으로 RECHECK가 최종 결정하도록 하는 순서를 제안합니다. RECHECK가 계속 wet이면 host는 30분 동안 추가 동작을 하지 않습니다. 반복 reset loop는 block을 가열해 measurement를 왜곡할 수 있으므로 attempt를 rate-limit하고 기록해야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Mei Tan
turns.en: I can approve that sequence for an internal cohort with two additions. First, the device must sample connector temperature from the port sensor, not battery temperature, because they diverge after leaving a heated vehicle. Second, any sensor value outside minus twenty to sixty degrees is invalid and must fail closed. The margin table will be signed data tied to controller revision P17; it cannot be a generic remote configuration. The attempt limit is one automatic re-evaluation per detach event and no more than three in twenty-four hours. A manual support action may request another scan only after a new detach event. We should log reason codes without storing raw high-resolution waveforms in consumer telemetry. Service builds may collect the waveform with explicit diagnostic consent.
turns.ko: 두 가지 조건을 추가하면 내부 cohort에서 그 순서를 승인할 수 있습니다. 첫째, heated vehicle에서 나온 뒤 connector와 battery temperature가 달라지므로 battery가 아니라 port sensor의 connector temperature를 사용해야 합니다. 둘째, 영하 20도~60도 범위를 벗어난 sensor 값은 invalid로 보고 fail closed해야 합니다. margin table은 controller revision P17에 결속된 signed data여야 하며 generic remote configuration이면 안 됩니다. attempt limit은 detach event당 자동 re-evaluation 1회, 24시간당 최대 3회입니다. 수동 support action도 새로운 detach event 뒤에만 추가 scan을 요청할 수 있습니다. 소비자 telemetry에는 raw high-resolution waveform을 저장하지 않고 reason code만 기록해야 합니다. service build는 명시적 diagnostic 동의가 있을 때 waveform을 수집할 수 있습니다.

turns.speaker: Jonas Weber
turns.en: From release operations, the containment can ship as component C4.8 without rebuilding the full image, but eligibility must be server-generated from signed device facts: model, controller revision, firmware P17, and F92.3 build fingerprint. The device must verify that token before exposing the flow. We will start with five hundred employee devices in cold chambers and outdoor commuting, then one thousand opted-in field devices in the three affected markets. No other model enters the cohort. Expansion stops for any confirmed wet-port clear, temperature-sensor invalidity above 0.1 percent, repeated automatic attempts, or charging enablement before controller RECHECK returns dry. If the component cannot validate identity, it remains inactive. Rollback removes the flow but leaves the original moisture protection unchanged.
turns.ko: 릴리스 운영 관점에서 억제책은 full image를 다시 build하지 않고 component C4.8로 배포할 수 있지만 eligibility는 model, controller revision, firmware P17, F92.3 build fingerprint라는 signed device fact로 server에서 생성해야 합니다. 단말은 flow를 노출하기 전에 그 token을 검증해야 합니다. cold chamber와 야외 출퇴근을 포함한 직원 단말 500대로 시작하고, 영향 시장 3곳의 opt-in field device 1,000대로 확대합니다. 다른 model은 cohort에 들어가지 않습니다. 실제 wet-port clear 확인, temperature-sensor invalidity 0.1% 초과, 반복 automatic attempt, controller RECHECK가 dry를 반환하기 전 charging enablement가 한 건이라도 있으면 확대를 중단합니다. component가 identity를 검증하지 못하면 inactive로 남습니다. rollback은 flow만 제거하고 기존 moisture protection은 그대로 둡니다.

turns.speaker: Sora Kim
turns.en: The decision is to pause Kestrel Mini F92.3 expansion at current percentages while leaving the full-size model unchanged. We approve component C4.8 for a bounded internal pilot on exact P17 hardware. The flow requires three seconds of physical detach, absent VBUS, valid connector temperature, an analog-block reset, the specified settle interval, two passing four-channel scans fifty milliseconds apart, and a final controller RECHECK result of dry. It never directly clears the hardware latch and never energizes the port during diagnosis. One attempt is allowed per detach event, with a maximum of three per day. We reject timer-only clearing, configuration-pin-only tests, generic threshold downloads, and a broad rollback at this stage.
turns.ko: 결정은 Kestrel Mini F92.3 확대를 현재 비율에서 멈추고 full-size model은 그대로 두는 것입니다. 정확한 P17 hardware에 대한 제한된 internal pilot으로 component C4.8을 승인합니다. flow는 physical detach 3초, VBUS 부재, 유효한 connector temperature, analog-block reset, 지정 settle interval, 50밀리초 간격의 4-channel scan 2회 통과, controller RECHECK의 최종 dry 결과를 요구합니다. hardware latch를 직접 지우지 않고 diagnosis 중 port에 전원을 공급하지 않습니다. detach event당 attempt 1회, 하루 최대 3회입니다. timer-only clearing, configuration-pin-only test, generic threshold download, 현 단계의 광범위 rollback은 거부합니다.

turns.speaker: Daniel Ortiz
turns.en: I own the BSP containment and permanent sequencing fix. By 12:00 KST on November 20, I will post the C4.8 patch with controller identity checks, detach and VBUS guards, monotonic attempt counters, and structured reason codes. By 17:00, I will provide fault injection for stale baseline, missing channel, contradictory pins, invalid temperature, and a charger inserted during scanning. The permanent F92.4 patch is due November 23 at 14:00. It will wait for analog-baseline-valid rather than digital-ready and will record the first four samples before any latch decision. Unit tests must prove that reboot, process restart, clock change, and component rollback cannot reset the daily attempt budget or bypass the controller’s final decision.
turns.ko: BSP 억제책과 영구 sequencing fix는 제가 담당합니다. 11월 20일 12시(KST)까지 controller identity check, detach·VBUS guard, monotonic attempt counter, structured reason code가 포함된 C4.8 patch를 게시합니다. 17시까지 stale baseline, missing channel, contradictory pin, invalid temperature, scanning 중 charger 연결에 대한 fault injection을 제공합니다. 영구 F92.4 patch는 11월 23일 14시까지입니다. digital-ready가 아니라 analog-baseline-valid를 기다리고 latch 결정 전에 첫 4개 sample을 기록합니다. unit test는 reboot, process restart, clock change, component rollback이 daily attempt budget을 reset하거나 controller의 최종 결정을 우회하지 못함을 입증해야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Mei Tan
turns.en: I own the electrical safety table and wet-fixture qualification. The signed P17 margin table is due at 13:00 KST today with temperature bands, convergence limits, paired-channel variance, and sensor-validity bounds. By November 22 at 18:00, my team will complete nine hundred cycles across clean, distilled-water, saline, road-salt, lint, and bent-pin fixtures at minus fifteen, zero, and twenty-five degrees. Hard failures are any wet fixture declared dry, any VBUS pulse during diagnosis, any analog reset with an attached cable, or any dry fixture cleared without two complete scans. The dry false-retention target is below one in five thousand cycles, and median recovery must remain under four hundred milliseconds after the three-second detach guard.
turns.ko: electrical safety table과 wet-fixture qualification은 제가 담당합니다. temperature band, convergence limit, paired-channel variance, sensor-validity bound가 포함된 signed P17 margin table을 오늘 13시(KST)까지 제공합니다. 11월 22일 18시까지 clean, distilled-water, saline, road-salt, lint, bent-pin fixture를 영하 15도, 0도, 25도에서 총 900 cycle 시험합니다. hard failure는 wet fixture가 dry로 선언되는 경우, diagnosis 중 VBUS pulse, cable 연결 상태의 analog reset, 완전한 scan 2회 없이 dry fixture가 해제되는 경우입니다. dry false-retention 목표는 5,000 cycle당 1건 미만이며 median recovery는 3초 detach guard 이후 400밀리초 미만이어야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Aisha Rahman
turns.en: I own field classification, support wording, and service evidence. By 11:00 KST today, I will update the intake form with model, build, controller revision, ambient estimate, prior vehicle session, detach duration, four-channel reason code, and whether physical residue was observed. Support will never tell a user to ignore a moisture warning or repeatedly reconnect a charger. The instruction is to disconnect, inspect the port, allow it to dry, and use wireless charging if available. C4.8 is offered only when device telemetry proves eligibility; agents cannot force enrollment. By November 23 at 09:00, I will publish separate counts for confirmed contamination, baseline-recovery signature, inconclusive evidence, successful guarded re-evaluation, and service replacement. Missing electrical evidence remains inconclusive.
turns.ko: 현장 분류, support 문구, service evidence는 제가 담당합니다. 오늘 11시(KST)까지 intake form에 model, build, controller revision, ambient estimate, 이전 vehicle session, detach duration, 4-channel reason code, 물리적 잔류물 관찰 여부를 추가합니다. 지원팀은 moisture warning을 무시하거나 charger를 반복 재연결하라고 안내하지 않습니다. cable을 분리하고 port를 살펴보며 건조시키고 가능하면 wireless charging을 사용하라는 지침입니다. C4.8은 device telemetry가 eligibility를 입증할 때만 제공하며 agent가 enrollment를 강제할 수 없습니다. 11월 23일 9시까지 confirmed contamination, baseline-recovery signature, inconclusive evidence, successful guarded re-evaluation, service replacement를 분리 집계해 게시합니다. electrical evidence가 없으면 inconclusive로 유지합니다.

turns.speaker: Jonas Weber
turns.en: I own cohort control, dashboards, and rollback. The five-hundred-device internal pilot begins November 20 at 19:00 KST after all injected safety tests pass. The one-thousand-device field pilot may begin November 23 at 15:00 only if the fixture report has zero hard failures and internal devices complete at least two thousand cold role-swap cycles. Dashboard gates are warning incidence, eligible-flow exposure, scan outcome, controller decision, attempt count, charging-enable timestamp, and rollback status by model and market. Any safety hard failure freezes new tokens within fifteen minutes and removes C4.8 from unclaimed devices. Already installed devices retain the original latch behavior if the flow is disabled. We will rehearse server-token withdrawal and local component rollback before field expansion.
turns.ko: cohort control, dashboard, rollback은 제가 담당합니다. 주입 safety test가 모두 통과하면 500대 internal pilot을 11월 20일 19시(KST)에 시작합니다. fixture report에 hard failure가 0건이고 internal device가 cold role-swap cycle을 최소 2,000회 완료해야 1,000대 field pilot을 11월 23일 15시에 시작할 수 있습니다. dashboard gate는 model·market별 warning incidence, eligible-flow exposure, scan outcome, controller decision, attempt count, charging-enable timestamp, rollback status입니다. safety hard failure가 하나라도 발생하면 15분 안에 새 token을 중단하고 아직 claim하지 않은 device에서 C4.8을 제거합니다. 이미 설치된 device도 flow가 disabled되면 기존 latch behavior를 유지합니다. field 확대 전에 server-token withdrawal과 local component rollback을 rehearsal합니다.

turns.speaker: Sora Kim
turns.en: The containment review is November 23 at 13:00 KST. Required evidence is the signed margin table, fault-injection results, nine-hundred-cycle fixture report, two-thousand-cycle internal run, support readiness, telemetry completeness, and rollback rehearsal. If all gates pass, the field pilot starts at fifteen hundred total devices and remains there for forty-eight hours. The permanent F92.4 go-or-hold meeting is November 25 at 16:30 KST. Expansion beyond the pilot requires zero wet-to-dry errors, zero premature charging events, no unexplained attempt-budget reset, telemetry completeness above 99.5 percent, and a warning rate below two per ten thousand devices. Review packets are due two hours before each meeting, and all stated times are Korea Standard Time.
turns.ko: 억제책 review는 11월 23일 13시(KST)입니다. 필요한 evidence는 signed margin table, fault-injection result, 900-cycle fixture report, 2,000-cycle internal run, support readiness, telemetry completeness, rollback rehearsal입니다. 모든 gate를 통과하면 field pilot은 총 1,500대에서 시작해 48시간 유지합니다. 영구 F92.4 go-or-hold meeting은 11월 25일 16시 30분(KST)입니다. pilot 이상 확대에는 wet-to-dry error 0건, premature charging event 0건, 설명되지 않은 attempt-budget reset 0건, telemetry completeness 99.5% 초과, device 1만 대당 warning 2건 미만이 필요합니다. review packet은 각 회의 2시간 전까지 제출하며 모든 시간은 Korea Standard Time입니다.

turns.speaker: Mei Tan
turns.en: One final safety boundary should appear in the minutes. A successful guarded re-evaluation means the controller observed a dry electrical state at that moment; it does not prove the port was never exposed to liquid, and it does not authorize repeated testing of a damaged connector. If the warning returns during the same detach event, the device must remain latched and direct the user to inspection. Bent pins, debris, sensor disagreement, or excessive variance are not candidates for software recovery. We should measure customer relief without turning a safety diagnostic into a convenience button. The user interface will therefore show the flow only after cable removal and automatic eligibility checks, not as a permanent settings option. Service teams retain the authority to quarantine hardware.
turns.ko: 마지막 safety boundary를 회의록에 넣어야 합니다. guarded re-evaluation 성공은 controller가 그 순간 dry electrical state를 관찰했다는 뜻이지 port가 liquid에 노출된 적이 없음을 입증하거나 손상된 connector를 반복 test하도록 허가하는 것이 아닙니다. 같은 detach event에서 warning이 돌아오면 device는 latch를 유지하고 사용자에게 점검을 안내해야 합니다. bent pin, debris, sensor disagreement, excessive variance는 software recovery 대상이 아닙니다. safety diagnostic을 편의 button으로 만들지 않으면서 고객 불편 해소를 측정해야 합니다. 그래서 UI는 cable removal과 자동 eligibility check 뒤에만 flow를 보이고 permanent settings option으로 제공하지 않습니다. service team은 hardware quarantine 권한을 유지합니다.

turns.speaker: Daniel Ortiz
turns.en: For permanent prevention, I will add a contract test between the host driver and every supported controller revision. The test will distinguish digital-ready, analog-powered, baseline-valid, and measurement-complete states instead of mapping them all to ready. Each controller adapter must declare its minimum settle rule and whether baseline survives low-power transitions. CI will run cold-start, warm-reset, role-swap, accessory detach, and charger-insertion sequences with randomized timing. A new controller cannot reuse another revision’s semantics without explicit review. We will also keep the first-sample sequence in bounded diagnostic memory so future investigations do not start from a final latch bit. This turns the lesson into an interface requirement rather than another model-specific delay.
turns.ko: 영구 예방을 위해 host driver와 지원하는 모든 controller revision 사이에 contract test를 추가하겠습니다. test는 digital-ready, analog-powered, baseline-valid, measurement-complete state를 모두 ready로 mapping하지 않고 구분합니다. 각 controller adapter는 최소 settle rule과 low-power transition 뒤 baseline 유지 여부를 선언해야 합니다. CI는 randomized timing으로 cold-start, warm-reset, role-swap, accessory detach, charger-insertion sequence를 실행합니다. 새 controller는 명시적 review 없이 다른 revision의 semantics를 재사용할 수 없습니다. 향후 조사가 final latch bit에서 시작하지 않도록 first-sample sequence도 bounded diagnostic memory에 유지합니다. 이를 통해 이번 교훈을 또 다른 model-specific delay가 아니라 interface requirement로 전환합니다.

turns.speaker: Sora Kim
turns.en: Let me read back the decision. Kestrel Mini F92.3 expansion is paused, while other models remain unchanged. C4.8 may run only on verified P17 devices and only after physical detach, absent VBUS, valid connector temperature, analog reset, two complete passing scans, and a dry controller RECHECK. No host code directly clears the latch, no diagnostic energizes the port, and no agent forces enrollment. Daniel owns containment and F92.4, Mei owns electrical safety, Aisha owns field evidence, Jonas owns cohorts and rollback, and I own the incident decision log. The containment review is November 23 at 13:00 KST, and the permanent decision is November 25 at 16:30 KST. I will circulate minutes by 09:15 today.
turns.ko: 결정을 다시 읽겠습니다. Kestrel Mini F92.3 확대는 중단하고 다른 model은 변경하지 않습니다. C4.8은 검증된 P17 device에서만 physical detach, VBUS 부재, 유효한 connector temperature, analog reset, 완전한 scan 2회 통과, dry controller RECHECK 뒤에만 실행할 수 있습니다. host code는 latch를 직접 지우지 않고 diagnostic은 port에 전원을 공급하지 않으며 agent는 enrollment를 강제하지 않습니다. Daniel은 억제책과 F92.4, Mei는 electrical safety, Aisha는 field evidence, Jonas는 cohort·rollback, 저는 incident decision log를 담당합니다. 억제책 review는 11월 23일 13시(KST), 영구 결정은 11월 25일 16시 30분(KST)입니다. 오늘 9시 15분까지 회의록을 배포하겠습니다.

expressions.phrase: separate genuine contamination from a false safety latch
expressions.meaning_ko: 실제 오염과 잘못된 safety latch를 구분하다
expressions.example: Thanks for joining the field escalation. Field Quality, USB and BSP, Power and Charging, and Release Operations are represented. Since Monday, we have received forty-three reports that wired charging remained blocked by a moisture warning after users left a cold vehicle. Thirty-six reports involve model Kestrel Mini on build F92.3, and most users say the port was visibly dry. The common sequence is vehicle data mode, ignition off, cable removal, and wall-charger insertion within two minutes. Today we need to separate genuine contamination from a false safety latch, decide whether the rollout should pause, define a containment that never energizes a wet port, assign permanent fixes, and agree on measurable field gates and a follow-up meeting.
expressions.practice: The review must separate a real leak from a stale alarm.

expressions.example: I reviewed support calls and service inspections. Seventeen affected devices reached a service center. Swab tests found no conductive residue on fourteen, light road-salt residue on two, and visible moisture on one. The one wet device cleared normally after drying, so it does not match the persistent pattern. On the fourteen clean devices, the warning survived three cable changes and a normal reboot but cleared after the battery fell below twenty percent or after a full power-off lasting more than five minutes. That behavior points to retained controller state rather than continuing leakage. However, customer statements alone cannot establish dryness. Any remote recovery must still require electrical evidence from both configuration-channel pins and the sideband pair.
expressions.practice: The reboot behavior points to retained controller state.

expressions.usage_ko: 단일 결과가 아닌 연속 증거를 요구할 때
expressions.example: USB and BSP is present. The host trace shows a role swap from source to sink while the port controller is leaving vehicle accessory mode. F92.3 added a faster detach path to reduce reconnect time. On the failing model, that path requests moisture sampling before the analog block has restored its temperature-compensated baseline. The first sample is roughly eighteen percent below the warm baseline and crosses the wet threshold. The controller then sets a hardware latch, while Android records only the final wet state. A normal reboot does not reset the always-on controller, which explains persistence. I cannot yet say the latch is false in every report because salt contamination can create the same first sample. We need the complete sample sequence, not a single threshold bit.
expressions.practice: Please attach the complete sample sequence to the incident.

expressions.example: Power and Charging is represented. Safety policy intentionally favors false positives because energizing a contaminated connector can cause corrosion or heating. I will oppose any proposal that clears the latch merely because a timer expires or a charger is reinserted. The electrical distinction is recovery shape. A dry port sampled before baseline restoration begins low, then converges toward the calibrated reference as the analog block stabilizes. Real conductive contamination remains low or becomes less stable when a small diagnostic bias is alternated. We can use that distinction only within the controller’s certified diagnostic current. The host must not apply VBUS during the test. We also need ambient and connector temperature, because a cold but dry port can converge more slowly than our laboratory profile.
expressions.practice: Our safety gate favors false positives when evidence is incomplete.

expressions.usage_ko: 적용 범위를 증거에 맞게 제한할 때
expressions.example: Release Operations is here. F92.3 reached thirty percent of Kestrel Mini devices in three northern markets and ten percent elsewhere. The full-size Kestrel uses a different port-controller revision and has no matching reports. Warning incidence on Mini rose from 0.7 to 8.9 per ten thousand active devices after F92.3. Ninety-two percent of events occur below five degrees Celsius, and seventy-eight percent follow a vehicle accessory session. That concentration justifies pausing expansion, but it does not justify a global rollback yet. F92.3 also fixes an unrelated charging negotiation reset. We need a model- and condition-specific decision with evidence that the old build does not expose the same latch under a different trigger.
expressions.practice: The evidence supports a model- and condition-specific decision.

expressions.usage_ko: 의미 불일치의 소유권을 명확히 할 때
expressions.example: I aligned controller ticks with the kernel trace using the cable-detach interrupt, which is visible on both sides. In six reproduced failures, moisture sampling starts between 2.1 and 3.4 milliseconds after analog power returns. The controller specification requires at least twelve milliseconds below zero degrees and eight milliseconds above zero. The accelerated detach change removed a fixed ten-millisecond wait because the earlier controller revision reported ready immediately. On Mini, the ready bit means digital logic is awake, not that the analog baseline is valid. That semantic mismatch is the software defect. Still, Mei is right that waiting twelve milliseconds alone cannot prove dryness. A contaminated port will also be sampled later. The permanent fix must correct sequencing and preserve independent wet detection.
expressions.practice: The contract mismatch, not the sensor, is the software defect.

expressions.phrase: require two consecutive complete four-channel scans
expressions.example: Our bench matrix supports that boundary. We tested clean, distilled-water, saline-mist, and road-salt ports at minus ten, zero, and twenty degrees. Clean ports converge within twenty-eight milliseconds at minus ten. Distilled water remains below threshold for at least four hundred milliseconds. Salt can briefly approach the dry range on one pin, but the paired sideband measurement stays abnormal and the alternating-bias variance exceeds the clean limit. I disagree with using convergence on the configuration pins alone. The controller exposes four channels for a reason. The containment should require two consecutive complete four-channel scans, separated by fifty milliseconds, with temperature-adjusted margins. Any missing channel, rising variance, or contradictory pin result must keep the latch set and instruct the user to disconnect the cable.
expressions.practice: The policy should require two consecutive complete four-channel scans.

expressions.example: We also reproduced a misleading recovery. If a wall charger remains attached while the latch is cleared, its pull-up changes the configuration-channel voltage and makes a contaminated fixture look closer to dry. Therefore the diagnostic must run with every external cable detached. Support cannot reliably ask users to measure that condition while the phone is unattended, so the flow needs explicit cable-state confirmation from hardware and a clear screen instruction. I propose that the device collect the two scans only after it observes detach continuously for three seconds. If the scan passes, it may clear the software copy and request the controller’s certified re-evaluation command. It must not directly clear the hardware latch. That preserves controller ownership of the final safety decision.
expressions.practice: The recheck command preserves controller ownership of the decision.

expressions.example: We need a field containment before a firmware image is ready. Option one is to roll Kestrel Mini back to F92.2. Option two is to keep F92.3 and add the guarded re-evaluation flow through a small system component update. Option three is to tell users to power off for five minutes. The third option is operational guidance, not an engineering containment. A rollback may reintroduce the negotiation reset, which caused charging interruptions for fleet users. I prefer pausing F92.3 at its current cohorts and delivering the guarded flow only to devices with the exact Mini controller identity. However, we must prove the existing controller command performs a fresh four-channel measurement and does not simply clear the prior status.
expressions.practice: A reboot instruction is not an engineering containment.

expressions.example: The command named RECHECK does perform a new measurement, but firmware P17 reuses the previous baseline estimate if analog power was never cycled. That is exactly the state we distrust. We can safely request an analog-block reset without resetting the entire controller, provided no cable is attached and VBUS is absent. The reset takes thirty-five milliseconds and preserves USB policy state. I propose this sequence: verify three seconds of detach, reset only the analog block, wait the temperature-specific settle time, collect two scans, then ask RECHECK to make the final decision. If RECHECK remains wet, the host does nothing further for thirty minutes. Repeated reset loops could heat the block and distort the measurement, so the attempt must be rate-limited and recorded.
expressions.practice: The retry must perform a new measurement before clearing anything.

expressions.phrase: is invalid and must fail closed
expressions.meaning_ko: 유효하지 않으며 안전 차단 상태로 실패해야 한다
expressions.example: I can approve that sequence for an internal cohort with two additions. First, the device must sample connector temperature from the port sensor, not battery temperature, because they diverge after leaving a heated vehicle. Second, any sensor value outside minus twenty to sixty degrees is invalid and must fail closed. The margin table will be signed data tied to controller revision P17; it cannot be a generic remote configuration. The attempt limit is one automatic re-evaluation per detach event and no more than three in twenty-four hours. A manual support action may request another scan only after a new detach event. We should log reason codes without storing raw high-resolution waveforms in consumer telemetry. Service builds may collect the waveform with explicit diagnostic consent.
expressions.practice: A checksum mismatch is invalid and must fail closed.

expressions.usage_ko: 자격 검증 실패 시 동작을 막을 때
expressions.example: From release operations, the containment can ship as component C4.8 without rebuilding the full image, but eligibility must be server-generated from signed device facts: model, controller revision, firmware P17, and F92.3 build fingerprint. The device must verify that token before exposing the flow. We will start with five hundred employee devices in cold chambers and outdoor commuting, then one thousand opted-in field devices in the three affected markets. No other model enters the cohort. Expansion stops for any confirmed wet-port clear, temperature-sensor invalidity above 0.1 percent, repeated automatic attempts, or charging enablement before controller RECHECK returns dry. If the component cannot validate identity, it remains inactive. Rollback removes the flow but leaves the original moisture protection unchanged.
expressions.practice: The feature remains inactive when identity cannot be verified.

expressions.example: I own the electrical safety table and wet-fixture qualification. The signed P17 margin table is due at 13:00 KST today with temperature bands, convergence limits, paired-channel variance, and sensor-validity bounds. By November 22 at 18:00, my team will complete nine hundred cycles across clean, distilled-water, saline, road-salt, lint, and bent-pin fixtures at minus fifteen, zero, and twenty-five degrees. Hard failures are any wet fixture declared dry, any VBUS pulse during diagnosis, any analog reset with an attached cable, or any dry fixture cleared without two complete scans. The dry false-retention target is below one in five thousand cycles, and median recovery must remain under four hundred milliseconds after the three-second detach guard.
expressions.practice: Hard failures must block the pilot even when recovery speed improves.

expressions.usage_ko: 증거 부족을 과도하게 분류하지 않을 때
expressions.example: I own field classification, support wording, and service evidence. By 11:00 KST today, I will update the intake form with model, build, controller revision, ambient estimate, prior vehicle session, detach duration, four-channel reason code, and whether physical residue was observed. Support will never tell a user to ignore a moisture warning or repeatedly reconnect a charger. The instruction is to disconnect, inspect the port, allow it to dry, and use wireless charging if available. C4.8 is offered only when device telemetry proves eligibility; agents cannot force enrollment. By November 23 at 09:00, I will publish separate counts for confirmed contamination, baseline-recovery signature, inconclusive evidence, successful guarded re-evaluation, and service replacement. Missing electrical evidence remains inconclusive.
expressions.practice: Missing electrical evidence remains inconclusive in the field report.

expressions.usage_ko: 모델별 교훈을 공통 계약으로 일반화할 때
expressions.example: For permanent prevention, I will add a contract test between the host driver and every supported controller revision. The test will distinguish digital-ready, analog-powered, baseline-valid, and measurement-complete states instead of mapping them all to ready. Each controller adapter must declare its minimum settle rule and whether baseline survives low-power transitions. CI will run cold-start, warm-reset, role-swap, accessory detach, and charger-insertion sequences with randomized timing. A new controller cannot reuse another revision’s semantics without explicit review. We will also keep the first-sample sequence in bounded diagnostic memory so future investigations do not start from a final latch bit. This turns the lesson into an interface requirement rather than another model-specific delay.
expressions.practice: We converted the timing assumption into an interface requirement.
